name: live-v25-11-a7-idless-import
objective: v2.5 plan 11 L5 (A7), no model. A fresh import of an id-less story (test/fixtures/linear.story.json, title 'Linear Vault') keys by its title slug in the library and in the chat blob; re-importing the same content keeps one record with the same content hash; an edited re-import updates that one record in place (new content hash, same importedAt, edited description) instead of forking. Stories carry no version since 9460f28d (2026-10-07), so the record's content hash is what tells the versions apart. Run with --sandbox: cleanup removes the imported record by hash. The last step removes the linear-vault record itself: sandbox cleanup removes imports by the hash the CHAT plays, and after the edited re-import the library record carries the edited hash while the chat keeps its pinned copy, so the record would outlive the run (found live, lane 3 run 2). Step 1 proves the record did not exist before the run.

steps.eval: const lib = (SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']?.stories ?? []); const ids = lib.map((r) => r.id); if (ids.includes('linear-vault')) throw new Error(`the library already holds linear-vault, so this import is not fresh: ${JSON.stringify(ids)}`); globalThis.__v2511A7 = { count: lib.length }; return { libraryBefore: ids };

const lib = (SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']?.stories ?? []); const blob = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.story_orchestrator; const records = lib.filter((r) => r.id === 'linear-vault'); const result = { records: records.length, hash: records[0]?.hash ?? null, importedAt: records[0]?.importedAt ?? null, title: records[0]?.title ?? null, libraryCount: lib.length, selected: blob?.selectedStoryId ?? null, keys: Object.keys(blob?.stories ?? {}) }; if (result.records !== 1 || result.libraryCount !== globalThis.__v2511A7.count + 1) throw new Error(`an id-less import did not add exactly one record keyed by its title slug: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (result.selected !== 'linear-vault' || !result.keys.includes('linear-vault')) throw new Error(`the chat does not key the id-less story by its title slug: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (typeof result.hash !== 'string' || !result.hash) throw new Error(`the library record carries no content hash: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); globalThis.__v2511A7.hash = result.hash; globalThis.__v2511A7.importedAt = result.importedAt; return result;

const lib = (SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']?.stories ?? []); const records = lib.filter((r) => r.id === 'linear-vault'); const result = { records: records.length, hash: records[0]?.hash ?? null, importedAt: records[0]?.importedAt ?? null, libraryCount: lib.length }; if (result.records !== 1 || result.libraryCount !== globalThis.__v2511A7.count + 1 || result.hash !== globalThis.__v2511A7.hash || result.importedAt !== globalThis.__v2511A7.importedAt) throw new Error(`re-importing the same id-less story forked or changed it: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); return result;
